submissions.title: report generation feature from the jobs search results
submissions.description:
After a user completes a search for a set of jobs on the jobs page, there should be an option to generate a report based on those search results. The goal is to make it easier for our users to quickly share results they the find interesting. Ideally it should enable sharing via email with a quick commentary 

for example, if the user creates a search semantic search for 'AI Engineer', there should be a button at the same level as the Export button to generate the report. 

The report should have the gemini latest model do a synthesis of the types of roles in the report in a block at the top of the report. This would be based on the responsibilities of the job descriptions and then have a simple table of the jobs in the result. 

Not sure how to do it but I'd like anyone who receives the report to able to to click on the link and come to fintech talent brief without having to create an account to see there initial results. To go deeper into the insights they would need to log in.

submissions.title: Have a job that detects if a scraper is broken
submissions.description:
we should have a job or process that runs to detect if a scraper for a company is broken. It would need to detect at a minimum when no new jobs are detected for a company. Same with no jobs being closed. 

If the conditions are true it should send an email to the admins with an alert to follow up 

If the admin agrees there is an issue there should be a way for them to confirm the issue from the email, which would then trigger the creation of a bug in the feedback module, and the diagnosis and coding work to resolve the issues. This should be achievable with the existing feedback rails that exist in the application

submissions.title: Job posting generator
submissions.description: I want to be able to automatically generate a new job posting by selecting previous job postings and then having an llm automatically generate me a new posting based on those previous job postings. For example, if tangerine and wealth simple have posted for an AI engineer from the jobs page, I should be able to select those postings and click a button to say generate new posting. It should probably walk me through a few critical questions like the seniority level and then extract the information from those previous postings back to synthesize or create the new posting

submissions.title: Inferred company structure graph
submissions.description:
Based on the jobs being posted, we should create a feature that somehow links together the job postings to an overall company structure. For example, based on job postings and public roles announcements and possibly linked in posts (I know this would be hard), could we build some sort of visual map of a company structure or priorities. For example, Tangerine has put a focus on hiring for digital wealth and are building it out. This includes a new managing director for the role and a number of roles in support. There should be some sort of timeline or flow we can draw from these linked events. 

Similarly when questrade started to go after a banking licence, you can see a series of job postings linked to building that out. 

You'll need to research and iterate through various visualization concepts to come up with a way to do this effectively. 

We should create a tab on the main menu for 'TB Labs' that can contain new concepts like this before they get promoted into production and built into a permanent tab
